blocks.text: Era Zero now has 252 canonical roots and 72 provisional roots in 8 nine-root chunks. No completed review packet awaits a decision. The broad English translator remains blocked. A restricted explicit-ID renderer may cover only the 252 canonical roots and must reject provisional meanings, unapproved compounds, and underspecified grammar.

The next semantic block is DAT:100–122. It was not begun in this packet. The standing authorization permits it to proceed next under the same nine-root validation boundary. A full-family Data audit remains required after DAT:200–222. Gate 4, the compound architecture, and translator implementation remain deferred.
